audience: developers who track their coding time with WakaTime

useCases.title: See your coding hours by project and language
useCases.text: The AI reads daily summaries or aggregated stats for a date range: total time and breakdowns by project, language, editor and more.

useCases.title: Find your best coding day and daily average
useCases.text: The AI reads an insight for a range, such as best day, daily average, average per weekday or per-day totals.

useCases.title: Check if you are on track with your goals
useCases.text: The AI lists your coding goals with target, status and chart data per period, and opens one goal.

useCases.title: See the time spent coding on each commit
useCases.text: The AI lists the commits of a project with the time spent coding on each, filtered by author or branch. The project needs a connected repository.

useCases.title: Review team coding activity by day or member
useCases.text: The AI reads one day of activity for every developer on an organization dashboard, or one member's daily summaries over a range.

useCases.title: Look at a leaderboard
useCases.text: The AI reads the ranking of one of your private leaderboards, or the public leaderboard filtered by language or country.
